guitar.notes: Confirmed — Buddy Guy's polka-dot Fender Stratocaster is one of the most iconic blues guitar associations.

tone.target: warm blues lead with mild grit and roomy reverb
tone.profile: warm blues lead with mild grit and roomy reverb
tone.summary: A classic blues tone achieved using a tweed-style preamp (US Deluxe) combined with a gentle overdriver (Green OD) for grit, followed by a vintage amp model (UK 50) and finished with Spring Reverb.
